text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - An extraordinary session of parliament on Tuseday voted against an opposition proposal to dismiss Agriculture Minister Peter Baco.
- The overall volume of trade with privatisation bonds totalled 543.5 million crowns since the beginning of trading on August 5.
- Steel producer VSZ said it planned to increase in the near future its imports of coachwork steel sheets for Russian car maker VAZ Toglaitti to 100,000 tonnes a year, from the current 60,000 tonnes.
- The state-run bus transport company posted losses of around 426 million ncrowns in the first half of this year.
- Slovakia's major steel pipe producer Zeleziarne Podbrezova said it believed that the European Commission would cancel anti-dumping procedures against the firm.
HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - The 1996 potato harvest is expected to be some 86 percent higher than in 1995.

- Engineering company VSS Kosice has launched production and exports of water tank trucks for the United Arab Emirates army. VSS will export 34 trucks by the end of this year and some 400 next year, according to the 450 million crowns contract.
